description: A false-colour satellite image displaying a dense, dark reddish-purple coniferous forest landscape. The image shows vegetation in shades of red, consistent with Near-Infrared band imagery where healthy coniferous trees, specifically spruce, are the predominant land cover. Faint, lighter linear features, likely unpaved roads or clearings, are visible winding through the forest. Small, brighter bluish-white patches, possibly artificial structures or exposed ground, are present at the upper left. This image depicts "Other natural coniferous (spruce) forest" in Attali, Island of Evia, Greece, and is credited to N. Kolp.
